subject: Proportional credit structure request — unusual tail latency spikes
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@nadir.example.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@nadir.example.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intermittent tail latency spikes impacting inference jobs

Hi Priyom,

We're seeing a pattern of tail-latency spikes across several of our production routes between 02:00–04:30 UTC on 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-08. This has caused timeout-driven retries in our batch workers and a measurable customer impact (loss of throughput for short periods). I've attached the Nadir telemetry and a cropped dashboard.

We need to understand root cause and talk about remediation steps. Given the outage windows and the downstream retries, we will be requesting a goodwill credit for the affected billing period. Can you confirm who we need to speak to for an exception/concession and whether Redwood can propose a proportional credit (aligned to affected token/time slices) rather than a flat month?

Thanks,
Emma Liu
Head of Platform Engineering
Nadir Systems
[Attachment: nadir_latency_timeseries.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@nadir.example.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intermittent tail latency spikes impacting inference jobs

Emma — thanks for the telemetry, and I'm sorry for the impact. We're pulling the service traces and runtime metrics now and Neha (our reliability lead) is on standby to correlate KV-cache behavior + scheduling in those windows.

Proposed next steps:
- 30-min sync with Nadir ops + our infra/RTEs today (I'll share a calendar invite)
- We'll produce a short postmortem and a proposed operational mitigation (prefix caching tweak + temporary routing policy)
- On concessions: I can put forward a proportional credit proposal to our revenue execs — please confirm the specific invoice period you'd like us to apply any credit to and whether you prefer a percentage of that bill or token-time-based credit.

I'll follow up shortly with an internal note asking for exec sign-off on a preliminary offer.

— Priyom
Priyom Das | Account Executive, Strategic | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Intermittent tail latency spikes — credit proposal request

Karthik / Marissa — forwarding Nadir's telemetry (attached) and my notes from the ops sync. Key facts:
- Affected windows: 2026-11-07 02:00–04:30 UTC and 2026-11-08 02:00–03:50 UTC (roughly 4.5 hours total)
- Impact: intermittent tail latency spikes causing retries and effective throughput loss for a subset of customer jobs; Nadir estimates ~18% of job attempts in those windows were affected
- Customer asks for a proportional credit rather than a flat month; they want either (A) percent-of-invoice for the billing period that includes the windows, or (B) token/time-slice credit tied to the affected routes

Suggested commercial posture for exec: two paths to approve quickly — I want to know which you prefer to OK:
1) Conservative: 15% one-time credit on the invoice that covers 2026-11 billing period + complimentary 30 days of 'priority support' (no billing change)
2) More generous: 20% credit pro-rated to the affected hours (we do a token/time calculation) + one month free on the next billing cycle

Rationale: Nadir is a mid-enterprise strategic account (annual rev ~USD 420k) and product impact is limited in duration but visible to their customers. We want to restore trust quickly, avoid churn risk, and keep the credit bounded.

Attachments: nadir_latency_timeseries.pdf, latency-dashboard.png

If you want the token/time calculation we can run it but that will add a day. Need exec decision today to get something to the customer tomorrow.

— Priyom

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intermittent tail latency spikes — credit proposal request

Thanks for the summary, Priyom. I reviewed the telemetry and the commercial ask. Given the customer's size and the limited duration, I'm comfortable approving a bounded concession with conditions. Approve plan 1 with a small twist:

- Offer: 15% one-time credit on the impacted invoice period + 1 month of gratis service (applies to Redwood-hosted usage only).
- Condition: Nadir accepts two operational commitments — (a) we will deploy the prefix-caching change and routing fallback within 72 hours, and (b) Nadir agrees to a 60-day monitoring window and a short joint postmortem.
- Escalation clause: If we observe recurrence within 30 days at >10% job impact, reopen for a secondary remediation credit (to be defined).

Please draft the customer-facing concession email with the offer and attach a proposed credit stub (I want the finance team to see it before we finalize). I approve this path.

— Karthik Iyer
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@nadir.example.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intermittent tail latency spikes impacting inference jobs — goodwill concession

Emma — thanks again for your patience while we reviewed the telemetry. Per our internal approvals, Redwood can offer the following concession to address the impact your team experienced on 2026-11-07/08: 

Offer (approved):
- A one-time 15% credit applied to Nadir's invoice for the billing period that includes 2026-11-07/08.
- Complimentary one-month service credit (applies to hosted usage) to be applied to your next billing cycle.

Conditions:
- Redwood will implement the recommended prefix-caching tweak and routing fallback within 72 hours and provide a short joint postmortem within 7 business days.
- If Nadir experiences a recurrence >10% job impact during the next 30 days, we will open a secondary remediation review.

I've attached a proposed credit-invoice-stub for finance to use as a starting point and the cropped dashboard you sent (for visibility). If this is acceptable, reply and we'll issue the credit and confirm the implementation timeline.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Strategic | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-credit-invoice-stub.pdf (application/pdf)]
